title: A kbmon run whose budget ends mid-scan never saves redact.known's cache, so after any kb/public edit every short-budget coord read times out again
goal: A coord read whose panel budget ends before a cold redact.known scan finishes still leaves that scan to finish and save its cache (the panel need not wait for it), so a second short-budget read about 25 s later on the same home reads the cache warm and is ok; a cache write stays atomic and fail-quiet, and the panel never blocks past its budget

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time;h=tempfile.mkdtemp();e=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=h);s=os.path.join(h,'c.db');c=lambda *a:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','--store',s,*a],env=e,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True);c('put','ask/A1','--value','May I widen the touches of item A1?','--revision','0');c('post','--kind','ask','--field','id=A1','--field','to=operator','--field','ref=ask/A1');r=lambda:json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--store',s,'--panel','coord','--timeout','3'],env=e,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)['panels']['coord']['state'];r();time.sleep(25);sys.exit(r()!='ok')
